messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads up — exporting CSV from the eval dashboard's diff view is swapping the legend labels for quantized vs float models after the last UI PR. Seen on canary and staging. Example CSV header: model_variant,score,label ... labels say 'quantized' but values look like float. :confused:
Aj Patel: Can you paste repro steps?
Maria Chen: Steps:
1) open /console/evals/<eval-id>/diff
2) enable 'export CSV'
3) download -> check header
CSV snippet:
```
model_variant,rouge_l,accuracy,label
float-1,0.78,0.82,quantized
quant-8bit,0.76,0.80,float
```
Looks flipped.
Ravi Singh: Hmm that sounds like the legend mapping in the chart render -> export pipeline. We changed mapping keys to `variant_id` last week (commit 6a3f2b8). Might be a key mismatch.
Emily Zhao: I can reproduce on staging. Also noticed the diff tooltip shows correct labels, so bug might be in the export serializer.
Aj Patel: Filing quick issue and adding to triage. assigning to me. Repro + failing test attached: https://ci.redwood.dev/4782/ui-export-legend
ci-bot: Build 4782 failed — ui-export-legend e2e failed (see logs).
Aj Patel: Root cause: export uses `legendLabel` map which expects `display_name`, but our chart now emits `variant_id`. Fixing mapping and adding fallback.
Aj Patel: Push in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/1247 — small change in export serializer + unit test.
Maria Chen: can you add an e2e that downloads CSV and checks header mapping? That would catch regressions.
Aj Patel: Yup added e2e test `export-legend.spec.ts` and unit test for serializer. Also added a small migration to keep old key backward-compatible.
ci-bot: Build 4790 started.
ci-bot: Build 4790 passed — all ui tests green :tada:
Emily Zhao: Verified fix on staging, export headers correct now. :thumbsup: \nRavi Singh: Can we add a short dashboard smoke test to perf regression suite? If export triggers slow serializer we'll catch it.
Maria Chen: Good idea — filed PERF-318.
Aj Patel: Closing thread after merge.
Maria Chen: Thanks all! :heart:
